title: 您也是辛苦了
concept: single expressive golden bare foot with one sweat drop
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art candidate for achievement_medal_steps_tier_001, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but extremely simple premium collectible steps achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "您也是辛苦了" (you really worked hard too). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a simple chunky beveled gold rim and glossy mint-teal enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE large shiny golden bare foot, not a shoe, with a big tired face on the sole: two simple black oval eyes and one tiny exhausted mouth. Add one oversized blue sweat drop near the foot as the only secondary element. No towel, no shoe, no footprints, no route, no extra props.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, deliberately silly but premium, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: ultra-simple large readable silhouette, foot centered and dominant, expression large enough to read at 58pt UI size. Keep details minimal: no toenails, no wrinkles, no realistic anatomy, no texture clutter.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, comedic over-serious sympathy for a tired foot.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold foot, mint/electric teal enamel, clear blue sweat drop, small coral accent only on rim, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, beveled rim, smooth simple shapes. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no shoes, no socks, no towels, no footprints, no route line, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no postcards, no mailbox, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
